description: The Go toolchain and the indirect modules are compiled into the released binary,
as the require modules are. config:recommended gives only require updates the
'fix' type, which svu releases as a patch version; this rule gives the other two
the same type, so a security fix in the Go standard library or in a transitive
module is released too. It is set here and not in the shared preset because a
library's toolchain line never reaches its users.
